description: A customizable checkbox component for React Native. Supports text labels, custom images, colors, and click handling.

customExample.description: Render a checkbox with custom checked and unchecked images.

style.description: Custom style for the checkbox container.

leftText.description: Text label to the left of the checkbox.

leftTextStyle.description: Custom style for the left text label.

rightText.description: Text label to the right of the checkbox.

rightTextView.description: Custom React element to display on the right side.

rightTextStyle.description: Custom style for the right text label.

checkedImage.description: Custom image to display when the checkbox is checked.

unCheckedImage.description: Custom image to display when the checkbox is unchecked.

isChecked.description: Current checked state of the checkbox.

onClick.description: Callback function invoked when the checkbox is clicked.

checkBoxColor.description: Tint color applied to the checkbox image in both checked and unchecked state.

checkedCheckBoxColor.description: Tint color applied only to the checked state. Overrides checkBoxColor for checked state.

uncheckedCheckBoxColor.description: Tint color applied only to the unchecked state. Overrides checkBoxColor for unchecked state.

notes: Requires a state variable for `isChecked` to manage the checkbox state.
Custom images can be used for checked and unchecked states.
Supports left and right text labels or custom right elements.
`onClick` callback is required to handle state updates.
